headline: Kinzhal Carriers Trigger Alarms as Russia Widens Strikes Across Ukraine
subheadline: MiG-31K fighters departed Savasleyka with Kh-47M2 Kinzhal missiles as drone and bomb attacks hit Kyiv and eastern oblasts, while Yanbu loadings were suspended.
lede: Russia expanded pressure on Ukraine with MiG-31K launches of Kh-47M2 Kinzhal missiles, rocket drone waves against Kyiv and guided bomb attacks across Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk and Donetsk oblasts. The strikes wounded at least one person seriously and raised ballistic threat levels for Kyiv and Chernihiv to medium-high, while negotiations over energy-infrastructure attacks remain unresolved ahead of winter. In the Middle East, the IDF and Shin Bet confirmed the elimination of Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, and a second Hamas commander was killed in Khan Yunis. Saudi Arabia suspended Yanbu oil loadings after closing the East-West pipeline following a retaliatory attack attributed to Yemen, as cyber analysts reported Iranian-linked phishing malware targeting messaging apps.

sections.title: Kinzhal Alarms Rise Over Multi-Axis Russian Strikes
sections.body: MiG-31K fighters departed Savasleyka airfield carrying Kh-47M2 Kinzhal aeroballistic missiles, prompting nationwide air alarms and medium-high ballistic threat levels for Kyiv and Chernihiv oblasts. Multiple waves of rocket drones targeted Kyiv from Bryansk oblast, the Black Sea and Mykolaivshchyna directions, striking a Darnytskyi district gas station and Obolon district warehouses. At least one person was seriously wounded in the Kyiv strikes. Russian tactical aviation also dropped guided aerial bombs on Zaporizhzhia, Dnipropetrovsk and Donetsk oblasts.

sections.title: IDF Strikes Hamas Commanders as Yanbu Shipments Halt
sections.body: The IDF and Shin Bet confirmed an airstrike in southern Gaza eliminated Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid, who had directed brigade operations and militant training. A second Hamas commander was killed in a targeted night raid in Khan Yunis, extending systematic eliminations of leadership figures. Saudi Arabia suspended oil loadings at Yanbu after closing its East-West pipeline following a retaliatory attack attributed to Yemen. Cyber intelligence analysis said Iranian-linked actors used CHOSEN BRICK malware in phishing campaigns on popular messaging apps to compromise communications and extract confidential personal data.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: Russia is combining Kinzhal carrier launches, multi-direction drone waves and guided bombs while seeking to delay an energy-strike agreement until winter, signaling sustained coercive pressure on Ukraine. In Gaza, repeated commander eliminations indicate continued IDF pressure on Hamas command structures, while the Yanbu suspension shows regional retaliation disrupting oil loadings. Ukraine's failed interceptor drone tests reveal air-defense gaps as aerial threats intensify.
